versions.changelog:
geo-metrics-tracker 0.1.0 – Initial Release

- Introduces a comprehensive system design for real-time GEO metric tracking and alerting.
- Supports cataloging and monitoring key AI visibility metrics (AIGVR, SoM, citation volume, coverage, etc.) across major conversational platforms.
- Provides workflows for dashboards, time-series views, anomaly detection, and operational review routines.
- Offers guidance for integrating static GEO reports into continuous observability systems.
- Defines coordination points with related GEO skills for holistic metrics management.
